newsitem.title: USA: Iowa ends fiscal 1996 with $657 mln balance.
newsitem.headline: Iowa ends fiscal 1996 with $657 mln balance.

text.p: - Iowa ended fiscal 1996 on June 30 with a $657.1 million unreserved general fund balance, according to the state's comprehensive annual financial report released this week.
The balance represents a $222.4 million improvement over fiscal 1995, according to a news release from the Iowa Department of Revenue and Finance.

The department said the improvement was primarily related to the accumulation of cash reserves. The total fund balance in the general fund was $1,310.1 million, an increase of $340.6 million, or 35.1 percent, from the previous fiscal year.

With the accumulation of cash reserves and responsible financial management practices, Iowa has seen a $1 billion turn around in its unreserved general fund balance over the past four years, the news release said.
